* K3 implant · W6-T6 · loop-boundary enforcement (Axiom 2, §4.2.7, §4.5.7, Decision 3/8).\n *\n * COMPONENT TRIPLE\n * - Reason to exist : every push the harness makes lands ON A LOOP BOUNDARY — turn boundary for\n *                     control flow, tool-call boundary for interception (Decision 8) — and NEVER\n *                     truncates or rewrites loop-internal state (Axiom 2). Upstream already has\n *                     the boundary (steering delivery === \"next_turn_boundary\"); what it lacks\n *                     is the enforcement: nothing stops an intervention from mutating history\n *                     mid-loop, and budget exhaustion silently stops instead of producing a\n *                     ledgered HOLD. This module supplies the queue whose ONLY drain point is a\n *                     boundary, the state-intactness assertions that make mid-loop mutation a\n *                     thrown error, and the five-control circuit breaker whose exhaustion\n *                     semantics are HOLD-not-truncate (§4.5.7 hard rule: \"ran out\" must never\n *                     masquerade as \"passed\").\n * - Axiom binding   : Axiom 2 (interventions at loop boundaries only), Axiom 1 (breaker\n *                     controls are deterministic constants an LLM cannot talk its way past),\n *                     Axiom 9 (the breaker is part of the effort control surface).\n * - Deprecation     : the boundary-only drain and the state-intactness assertions are NOT\n *                     deprecable (they are Axiom 2's enforcement surface). Breaker parameters\n *                     may TIGHTEN (ledgered); loosening beyond upstream ceilings throws (W3\n *                     `assertNoLoosening`). The premature-switch detector retires only if the\n *                     obligation event family is retired.\n *\n * MOUNT POINT (Decision 3, D absorbed as C's carrier): the breaker checks ride the autonomous\n * gate evaluation path — `mountEffortOnAutonomousGates` returns the K3 verification commands\n * for `gates.commands` (a CARRIER, never the only gate: that surface is settings-clearable, so\n * the binding checks live in `checkCircuit` which the W3 gates call directly).\n *\n * INTERVENTION VOCABULARY (task card): when a premature topic switch is detected, the correct\n * intervention is RETURN TO THE UNCLOSED OBLIGATIONS — not \"think longer\". The PushKind union\n * deliberately has no member for extending reasoning: pressure on reasoning duration is\n * pressure inside the loop, which Axiom 2 forbids. Closed obligations get zero pressure.\n */\n\nimport { autonomousGateCommands, UPSTREAM_AUTONOMOUS_CEILINGS } from \"../gate/mount.js\";\nimport type { GateVerdict } from \"../gate/predicates.js\";\nimport type { EventLedger, LedgerRow } from \"../ledger/event-ledger.js\";\nimport { scanLedger } from \"../ledger/reader.js\";\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Boundaries and pushes\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/** Loop boundaries K3 recognises (Decision 8). There is no \"token\" member: streaming\n * interruption is excluded outright (it violates Axiom 1 and upstream offers no such surface). */\nexport type LoopBoundaryKind = \"turn\" | \"tool_call\" | \"phase\";\n\n/**\n * The complete intervention vocabulary. Note what is ABSENT: no \"think_longer\", no\n * \"extend_reasoning\", no \"write_more\" — pushing on reasoning duration or text volume is not an\n * intervention K3 can express, by construction.\n */\nexport type PushKind = \"return_to_unclosed_obligations\" | \"evidence_action\" | \"run_verifier\" | \"steer_topic_back\";\n\nexport const PUSH_KINDS: readonly PushKind[] = Object.freeze([\n\t\"return_to_unclosed_obligations\",\n\t\"evidence_action\",\n\t\"run_verifier\",\n\t\"steer_topic_back\",\n]);\n\nexport interface Push {\n\treadonly kind: PushKind;\n\t/** The boundary this push is delivered at. Control flow rides turns (Decision 8). */\n\treadonly boundary: LoopBoundaryKind;\n\t/** For evidence_action pushes: one of the four effort event types (ceiling.ts enforces). */\n\treadonly target?: string;\n\t/** For return_to_unclosed_obligations: the obligation ids to return to. */\n\treadonly obligations?: readonly string[];\n\treadonly reason: string;\n}\n\nexport class MidLoopPushError extends Error {\n\tconstructor(message: string) {\n\t\tsuper(message);\n\t\tthis.name = \"MidLoopPushError\";\n\t}\n}\n\nexport class LoopInternalMutationError extends Error {\n\tconstructor(message: string) {\n\t\tsuper(message);\n\t\tthis.name = \"LoopInternalMutationError\";\n\t}\n}\n\n/**\n * The push queue whose only drain point is a boundary. Queueing is allowed at any time (a\n * queued push touches nothing); DELIVERY happens exclusively when the loop reports a boundary.\n * The queue holds no reference to loop state at all — it structurally cannot rewrite what it\n * cannot reach.\n */\nexport class BoundaryPushQueue {\n\tprivate readonly queue: Push[] = [];\n\tprivate inSegment = false;\n\tprivate stateSnapshot: string | null = null;\n\n\t/** Marks the start of a loop segment; `state` is snapshotted for the intactness check. */\n\tenterSegment(state: unknown): void {\n\t\tthis.inSegment = true;\n\t\tthis.stateSnapshot = JSON.stringify(state);\n\t}\n\n\t/** Queue a push. ENVIRONMENT-NATURE CONSTRUCTION:\n * the view's backing array is a slice ending at t — bars after t are structurally ABSENT from\n * the object, not merely guarded behind an index check. Even full reflection over the view\n * cannot recover a future bar, because the FIFO loop has not delivered it yet (§6.2: 时间箭头由\n * 引擎结构实现).\n */\nexport interface MarketView {\n\t/** Number of bars visible (cursor position + 1). */\n\treadonly length: number;\n\t/** Bar at absolute index i (0-based); i must be ≤ cursor. */\n\tbar(i: number): Bar;\n\t/** Closes of the last n visible bars (for indicator windows). */\n\tcloses(n: number): readonly number[];\n\treadonly last: Bar;\n}\n\nfunction makeView(past: readonly Bar[]): MarketView {\n\t// `past` is already a defensive copy sliced at the cursor — the future is not in scope here.\n\treturn Object.freeze({\n\t\tlength: past.length,\n\t\tbar(i: number): Bar {\n\t\t\tif (i < 0 || i >= past.length) {\n\t\t\t\tthrow new LookaheadError(\n\t\t\t\t\t`bar(${i}) outside the visible window [0, ${past.length - 1}]: future events have not been generated yet`,\n\t\t\t\t);\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn past[i];\n\t\t},\n\t\tcloses(n: number): readonly number[] {\n\t\t\tconst k = Math.min(n, past.length);\n\t\t\treturn past.slice(past.length - k).map((b) => b.close);\n\t\t},\n\t\tlast: past[past.length - 1],\n\t});\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Strategy module — init/next interface; returns target position in [-1,1]. */\n\tnext(view: MarketView): number;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Execution module — t signal fills at t+1 open; events are appended in time order only\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport type EngineEvent =\n\t| { readonly kind: \"MARKET\"; readonly index: number }\n\t| { readonly kind: \"SIGNAL\"; readonly price: number };\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Performance + risk module — the JSON the verifier recomputes field by field\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport interface PerformanceReport {\n\treadonly strategy: string;\n\treadonly params: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;\n\treadonly data_hash: string;\n\treadonly bars: number;\n\treadonly trades: number;\n\treadonly final_equity: number;\n\treadonly total_return: number;\n\treadonly sharpe_annual: number; (peak - e) / peak : 0;\n\t\tif (dd > mdd) mdd = dd;\n\t}\n\treturn mdd;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// The engine — event-driven, deterministic, CSV in / JSON out\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nexport interface RunOptions {\n\t/** Ledger to mint the run row into (evidence runs); tests may omit and mint later. */\n\treadonly ledger?: EventLedger;\n\treadonly phase?: string;\n}\n\n/**\n * Runs the FIFO loop. FILL_TIMING) !== FILL_TIMING) {\n\t\tthrow new LookaheadError(\n\t\t\t`fillTiming \"${config.fillTiming}\" refused: signal at t must fill at t+1 open — a same-bar fill is ` +\n\t\t\t\t\"lookahead in disguise (engine timing check, §5.2 designed failure path ①)\",\n\t\t);\n\t}\n\tconst bars = parseOhlcvCsv(csv);\n\tif (bars.length < 3) throw new BacktestError(\"need ≥3 bars for a signal→fill→mark cycle\");\n\tconst costs = config.costs ?? * K3 implant Â· W6-T6 Â· loop-boundary enforcement (Axiom 2, Â§4.2.7, Â§4.5.7, Decision 3/8).\n *\n * COMPONENT TRIPLE\n * - Reason to exist : every push the harness makes lands ON A LOOP BOUNDARY â€?turn boundary for\n *                     control flow, tool-call boundary for interception (Decision 8) â€?and NEVER\n *                     truncates or rewrites loop-internal state (Axiom 2). Upstream already has\n *                     the boundary (steering delivery === \"next_turn_boundary\"); what it lacks\n *                     is the enforcement: nothing stops an intervention from mutating history\n *                     mid-loop, and budget exhaustion silently stops instead of producing a\n *                     ledgered HOLD. This module supplies the queue whose ONLY drain point is a\n *                     boundary, the state-intactness assertions that make mid-loop mutation a\n *                     thrown error, and the five-control circuit breaker whose exhaustion\n *                     semantics are HOLD-not-truncate (Â§4.5.7 hard rule: \"ran out\" must never\n *                     masquerade as \"passed\").\n * - Axiom binding   : Axiom 2 (interventions at loop boundaries only), Axiom 1 (breaker\n *                     controls are deterministic constants an LLM cannot talk its way past),\n *                     Axiom 9 (the breaker is part of the effort control surface).\n * - Deprecation     : the boundary-only drain and the state-intactness assertions are NOT\n *                     deprecable (they are Axiom 2's enforcement surface). Breaker parameters\n *                     may TIGHTEN (ledgered); loosening beyond upstream ceilings throws (W3\n *                     `assertNoLoosening`). The premature-switch detector retires only if the\n *                     obligation event family is retired.\n *\n * MOUNT POINT (Decision 3, D absorbed as C's carrier): the breaker checks ride the autonomous\n * gate evaluation path â€?`mountEffortOnAutonomousGates` returns the K3 verification commands\n * for `gates.commands` (a CARRIER, never the only gate: that surface is settings-clearable, so\n * the binding checks live in `checkCircuit` which the W3 gates call directly).\n *\n * INTERVENTION VOCABULARY (task card): when a premature topic switch is detected, the correct\n * intervention is RETURN TO THE UNCLOSED OBLIGATIONS â€?not \"think longer\". The PushKind union\n * deliberately has no member for extending reasoning: pressure on reasoning duration is\n * pressure inside the loop, which Axiom 2 forbids. Closed obligations get zero pressure.\n */\n\nimport { autonomousGateCommands, UPSTREAM_AUTONOMOUS_CEILINGS } from \"../gate/mount.js\";\nimport type { GateVerdict } from \"../gate/predicates.js\";\nimport type { EventLedger, LedgerRow } from \"../ledger/event-ledger.js\";\nimport { scanLedger } from \"../ledger/reader.js\";\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Boundaries and pushes\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/** Loop boundaries K3 recognises (Decision 8). There is no \"token\" member: streaming\n * interruption is excluded outright (it violates Axiom 1 and upstream offers no such surface). */\nexport type LoopBoundaryKind = \"turn\" | \"tool_call\" | \"phase\";\n\n/**\n * The complete intervention vocabulary. Note what is ABSENT: no \"think_longer\", no\n * \"extend_reasoning\", no \"write_more\" â€?pushing on reasoning duration or text volume is not an\n * intervention K3 can express, by construction.\n */\nexport type PushKind = \"return_to_unclosed_obligations\" | \"evidence_action\" | \"run_verifier\" | \"steer_topic_back\";\n\nexport const PUSH_KINDS: readonly PushKind[] = Object.freeze([\n\t\"return_to_unclosed_obligations\",\n\t\"evidence_action\",\n\t\"run_verifier\",\n\t\"steer_topic_back\",\n]);\n\nexport interface Push {\n\treadonly kind: PushKind;\n\t/** The boundary this push is delivered at. Control flow rides turns (Decision 8). */\n\treadonly boundary: LoopBoundaryKind;\n\t/** For evidence_action pushes: one of the four effort event types (ceiling.ts enforces). */\n\treadonly target?: string;\n\t/** For return_to_unclosed_obligations: the obligation ids to return to. */\n\treadonly obligations?: readonly string[];\n\treadonly reason: string;\n}\n\nexport class MidLoopPushError extends Error {\n\tconstructor(message: string) {\n\t\tsuper(message);\n\t\tthis.name = \"MidLoopPushError\";\n\t}\n}\n\nexport class LoopInternalMutationError extends Error {\n\tconstructor(message: string) {\n\t\tsuper(message);\n\t\tthis.name = \"LoopInternalMutationError\";\n\t}\n}\n\n/**\n * The push queue whose only drain point is a boundary. Queueing is allowed at any time (a\n * queued push touches nothing); DELIVERY happens exclusively when the loop reports a boundary.\n * The queue holds no reference to loop state at all â€?it structurally cannot rewrite what it\n * cannot reach.\n */\nexport class BoundaryPushQueue {\n\tprivate readonly queue: Push[] = [];\n\tprivate inSegment = false;\n\tprivate stateSnapshot: string | null = null;\n\n\t/** Marks the start of a loop segment; `state` is snapshotted for the intactness check. */\n\tenterSegment(state: unknown): void {\n\t\tthis.inSegment = true;\n\t\tthis.stateSnapshot = JSON.stringify(state);\n\t}\n\n\t/** Queue a push. #!/usr/bin/env bash
set -uo pipefail

db=/data/.k3-filebrowser/state/filebrowser.db
bin=/data/.k3-filebrowser/current/filebrowser
printf 'DIAG_AT=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
printf '%s\n' '--- stat/file/hash/header ---'
stat -c 'path=%n size=%s mode=%a owner=%U:%G mtime=%y' "$db" 2>&1
file -b "$db" 2>&1 || true
sha256sum "$db" 2>&1
od -An -tx1 -N32 "$db" 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- binary version/help commands ---'
"$bin" version 2>&1 || true
"$bin" --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,160p'
printf '%s\n' '--- config help ---'
"$bin" config cat --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,200p' || true
printf '%s\n' '--- users help ---'
"$bin" users ls --help 2>&1 | sed -n '1,200p' || true
printf '%s\n' '--- services ---'
systemctl show filebrowser-k3.service k3-p5-queue.service \
  -p Id -p LoadState -p ActiveState -p SubState -p Result -p ExecMainStatus 2>&1
printf '%s\n' '--- bootstrap fail record ---'
cat /data/k3/p5_bootstrap/hub_bootstrap_health.json 2>&1 || true
printf '%s\n' '--- latest evidence ---'
tail -n 120 /data/k3/p5_bootstrap/evidence/p0_live_install/20260810T143600Z/live.log 2>&1 || true
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
pid=14203
expected='/data/.k3-filebrowser/current/filebrowser --database /data/.k3-filebrowser/state/filebrowser.db --address 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 --root /data/k3 --log /data/.k3-filebrowser/logs/filebrowser.log --disableExec'
actual="$(ps -p "$pid" -o args= 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [ -n "$actual" ]; then
  [ "$actual" = "$expected" ] || { echo "refusing to signal unexpected PID $pid: $actual" >&2; exit 41; }
  kill -TERM "$pid"
  for _ in $(seq 1 20); do kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || break; sleep 0.5; done
  if kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then kill -KILL "$pid"; fi
fi
test -z "$(ss -H -lntp 'sport = :8080' || true)"
systemctl reset-failed filebrowser-k3.service k3-p5-queue.service
/data/k3/p5_bootstrap/hub/bootstrap_hub.sh
/data/k3/p5_bootstrap/hub/verify_p0_runtime.sh /data/k3/p5_bootstrap/hub
printf 'FILEBROWSER_ORPHAN_CLEARED=PASS\n'
